name: Automatic Cut-Away and Ghosted Views (Volumetric)
aliases: Automatic Cut-Away and Ghosted Views (Volumetric) — Importance-Driven Feature Enhancement
definition: An approach for automatically generating cut-away and ghosted views from volumetric data by employing additional information about the importance of particular features.
summary: Automatic Cut-Away and Ghosted Views uses an importance-based scheme to automatically select visible or suppressed features, generalizing traditional cut-aways by prioritizing semantic significance over fixed geometric planes.
